#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <climits>
#include <functional>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to;
    long long cost, cap;
    int rev;
    Edge(int to, long long cost, long long cap, int rev) : to(to), cost(cost), cap(cap), rev(rev) {}
};

struct Graph {
    int V;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    Graph(int V) : V(V), adj(V) {}
    void addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, long long weight, long long capacity) {
        Edge a(to, weight, capacity, adj[to].size());
        Edge b(from, -weight, 0, adj[from].size());
        adj[from].push_back(a);
        adj[to].push_back(b);
    }
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    Graph &g;
    int s, t;
    vector<long long> potential, dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;
    const long long INF = (1LL << 60);

    MinCostFlow(Graph &g, int s, int t, bool hasNegative) : g(g), s(s), t(t) {
        potential.assign(g.V, INF);
        dist.assign(g.V, INF);
        prevv.assign(g.V, 0);
        preve.assign(g.V, 0);
        if (hasNegative) {
            potential[s] = 0;
            bool updated;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.V; ++i) {
                updated = false;
                for (int v = 0; v < g.V; ++v) {
                    if (potential[v] == INF) continue;
                    for (const Edge &e : g.adj[v]) {
                        if (e.cap > 0 && potential[e.to] > potential[v] + e.cost) {
                            potential[e.to] = potential[v] + e.cost;
                            updated = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
        }
    }

    pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX);
    }

    pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow(long long maxf) {
        long long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto cur = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                long long d = cur.first;
                int v = cur.second;
                if (dist[v] < d) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g.adj[v].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = g.adj[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        if (potential[v] == INF || potential[e.to] == INF) continue;
                        long long nd = d + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to];
                        if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            prevv[e.to] = v;
                            preve[e.to] = i;
                            pq.push({nd, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < g.V; ++v) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) {
                    if (potential[v] == INF) potential[v] = dist[v];
                    else potential[v] += dist[v];
                }
            }
            long long add = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                if (e.cap < add) add = e.cap;
            }
            flow += add;
            cost += add * potential[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= add;
                g.adj[e.to][e.rev].cap += add;
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }

    int pairCount = (n + 1) / 2;
    int V = n + 26 + 2;
    int source = V - 2;
    int sink = V - 1;
    Graph g(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; ++j) {
            int left = j;
            int right = n - 1 - j;
            long long w = 0;
            if (s[left] == s[right]) {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) {
                    w = -(long long)std::max(a[left], a[right]);
                }
            } else {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[left];
                if (s[right] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[right];
            }
            g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
        }
    }

    for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; ++j) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(j, sink, 0, 2);
    }

    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, sink, true);
    long long cost = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow().first;
    cout << -cost << endl;

    return 0;
}
